message.content:
Below is a concise “long‑weekend” calendar for Canada in 2023.  
A long weekend is defined as **three or more consecutive days off** that include a statutory holiday (or its observed day) and the adjacent Saturday‑Sunday weekend.  

> **NOTE:**  
> • The dates shown are the *actual holiday dates*; the “Observed” column indicates the day the holiday is officially taken if the statutory date falls on a weekend.  
> • Some holidays (e.g., Family Day, St. Patrick’s Day, etc.) are province‑specific.  The table below lists the federal holidays that create long weekends nationwide.  Provincial variations are noted where relevant.  
> • For a complete, province‑by‑province list, see the Government of Canada’s statutory holiday page or the individual provincial government sites.

| # | Holiday | 2023 Date | Observed (if weekend) | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---|---------|-----------|-----------------------|-------------------|-------|
| 1 | **New Year’s Day** | Sunday Jan 1 | Monday Jan 2 | **Jan 1–2** (2 days) | Only 2 days; still often counted as a “short” long weekend. |
| 2 | **Family Day** (Ontario, Alberta, etc.) | Monday Feb 20 | – | **Feb 18–20** | Province‑specific; other provinces have different dates. |
| 3 | **Good Friday** | Friday Apr 7 | – | **Apr 7–9** | 3‑day weekend. |
| 4 | **Victoria Day** | Monday May 22 | – | **May 20–22** | 3‑day weekend. |
| 5 | **Canada Day** | Saturday Jul 1 | Monday Jul 3 | **Jul 1–3** | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon). |
| 6 | **Labour Day** | Monday Sep 4 | – | **Sep 2–4** | 3‑day weekend. |
| 7 | **Thanksgiving** | Monday Oct 9 | – | **Oct 7–9** | 3‑day weekend. |
| 8 | **Remembrance Day** | Saturday Nov 11 | Monday Nov 13 | **Nov 11–13** | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon). |
| 9 | **Christmas Day** | Monday Dec 25 | – | **Dec 23–25** | 3‑day weekend. |
|10 | **Boxing Day** | Tuesday Dec 26 | – | **Dec 23–26** | 4‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon‑Tue). |

### Quick Reference (by month)

| Month | Long‑Weekend Dates | Holiday |
|-------|--------------------|---------|
| Jan | Jan 1–2 | New Year’s Day |
| Feb | Feb 18–20 | Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, etc.) |
| Apr | Apr 7–9 | Good Friday |
| May | May 20–22 | Victoria Day |
| Jul | Jul 1–3 | Canada Day |
| Sep | Sep 2–4 | Labour Day |
| Oct | Oct 7–9 | Thanksgiving |
| Nov | Nov 11–13 | Remembrance Day |
| Dec | Dec 23–26 | Christmas & Boxing Day |

### How to Use This Data

1. **Integrate into your app** – Store the dates in a calendar or database table.  
2. **Handle province‑specific holidays** – Add a lookup table that maps provinces to their Family Day dates (e.g., BC: Feb 20, 2023; Saskatchewan: Feb 20, 2023; etc.).  
3. **Account for observed days** – If a holiday falls on a weekend, use the “Observed” date for scheduling.  
4. **Future years** – The same logic applies; just recompute the dates (e.g., Good Friday is the Friday before Easter, Canada Day is July 1, etc.).

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the full provincial list or a programmatic way to generate these dates for any year!
